name: TextHighlighter
description: A marker highlight that sweeps behind text when it scrolls into view. The text itself is untouched, ordinary inline text that wraps normally.

color.description: Any CSS colour for the marker. Defaults to a soft tint of the action colour. Keep enough contrast with the text.

whenInView.description: Waits until the text scrolls into view before sweeping. When false it sweeps on load.

delay.description: Seconds to wait before the sweep starts.

isPaused.description: Stops the animation and shows the finished text. Moving content that lasts more than five seconds should be stoppable.

requirements: The marker is a background of the text element, so the text is never split, copied or re-announced
The marker colour must keep the text at 4.5:1 contrast; the default is a light tint
The marker runs once and then stays: nothing keeps moving
Decoration only: the animated layers are hidden from assistive technology and never take focus
Stands still for visitors who ask for less motion (prefers-reduced-motion), and can also be shown still with the rdm-still class or isPaused
In forced-colors (high contrast) mode the text is drawn in the system colours with no effect
Does not flash: nothing changes more than three times in a second (WCAG 2.3.1)
The text is real text in the server HTML, readable with no script
Optional: it is a separate component, so projects that do not add it carry none of its code

use_when: Drawing the eye to one key phrase in a paragraph
Marking a phrase as the point of a section
avoid_when: Dark or saturated marker colours that cut the text contrast
anti_patterns: Stacking several highlights in one sentence
Using the highlight as the only sign that text matters (add words or structure too)
